angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 751,356 km at 58.55 pc = 0.17 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 17.0807 +/- 0.0208 mas (same row, RUWE 1.07): 58.55 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.08 +/- 0.11 solar radii from Zhou et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HIP 94235 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..289Z/abstract): 751,356 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.094 +/- 0.024 solar masses from Zhou et al. 2022, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HIP 94235 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..289Z/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5991 +/- 50 K from Zhou et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HIP 94235 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..289Z/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Zhou et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HIP 94235 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..289Z/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hip-94235.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.410, rounded to two decimals

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, coloured from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
